full_judgment: 18. In the decision, in the case of Chittagong Port Authority Vs. Sadharan Bima reported in 1981 BLD (AD) 373 relied on by the learned Advocate for the petitioners, it has been held by the High Court Division in the decision, in the case of Tajor Rahman Vs. Trustees of the Port of Chittagong that Section 109(2) of 'the Chittagong Port Act has prescribed a special period of limitation of six months for a suit against the Port Trust. This decision was given by a Division Bench. But the High Court Division in the instant case has observed that "the previous decision can hardly be taken to be a precedent". The decision of one Division Bench may be agreed to by another Division Bench, but if the latter finds difficulty to agree with the previous decision, it is to refer the question to the Hon'ble Chief Justice for formation of a larger Bench for resolution of the matter. This has not been done in this case.
